description: Automated security checks for x402 endpoints — not a penetration test. POST /v1/audit ($0.50) runs eight non-destructive, unpaid probes against one paid route: paywall presence, challenge sanity, garbage and forged payment rejection, exposure surface, error hygiene, body-size cap, and discovery consistency. Returns SECURE / FINDINGS / EXPOSED with per-check results and a fix note per finding. Use this when you operate an x402 route and want its locks checked before an attacker rattles them.
